frase.texto: I am following with great concern the humanitarian crisis unfolding in parts of Somalia, where episodes of violence and extreme weather events are worsening the already precarious living conditions of the population, particularly women and children

fuente.titulo: Pope Leo prays for end to humanitarian crisis in Somalia - Vatican News

caption:
“I am following with great concern the humanitarian crisis unfolding in parts of Somalia, where episodes of violence and extreme weather events are worsening the already precarious living conditions of the population, particularly women and children”

— Pope Leo XIV, Angelus (2026)

Via Vatican News, 20 September 2026
